annotations.text:
1 — Home, signed in
Membership ฿349/mo (pink) + Elite Package ฿690/mo (premium black); real event cards for Wellness Wednesdays, Ice Bathing, Strength Challenge. Header shows the Kaiqing account chip + dropdown.

1b — Home, signed out
Same page before login/sign up — header shows Log In / Sign Up buttons top right instead of the account chip.

2 — Branches
Brand map (uniform pink pins) + live branch list. Tapping Book on any branch leads to Plan My Workout below.

2b — Plan My Workout
Reached after tapping Book on Branches. 24 hourly 1-hour slots as square boxes, 5 per row — pick one, then Confirm Booking.

5 — Verify Email
OTP sent after sign up; confirms account before first login.

6 — Successful Login
Confirmation state after verification / login completes.

7 — My Account (signed-in)
Web version of the mobile Profile page — avatar, membership, gym access QR code, HUMF Card, coupons, history, payment, help. HUMF Card row leads to Get HUMF Card; View My Performance row leads to My Performance.

8 — Get HUMF Card
Reached after tapping Get card on the Account page. Card preview + delivery form: name, email, address.

9 — My Performance
Reached after tapping View My Performance on the Account page. Tablet/horizontal layout pulling the mobile Performance page's style — rings row on top, stat boxes + connect device on the left, My Day / Today's Activities on the right.

10 — Memberships
Standalone page, not the landing-page teaser — a deep-dive selling-point breakdown per package. Starter: 78 branches, lowest price in Thailand, growth roadmap, 7/25/30-day streak rewards, Friday Run Club + partner logos, HUMF Card/NFC access, gamified 'Level Up Every Day' banner. Elite (dark section): skip-the-queue access, free parking, full facility + towel.

11 — My Coupons
Reached from the Account page's "My Coupons" row. Streak rewards, a referral reward, and a welcome offer — shown in active / used / expired states.

12 — Visit & Purchase History
Reached from the Account page. Branch check-in log on top (branch, time, duration), billing history below (charges + card used).

13 — Manage My Payment
Reached from the Account page's "Manage my payment" row. Saved cards with a default badge + Add card, plus billing history with receipt links.
